correctness.rationale: Walsh characters diagonalize the undirected unit-weight hypercube Laplacian with eigenspace dimensions binom(d,k); PBH forces at least the central binomial number of independently controlled vertex coordinates. The incidence up/down commutator DU-UD=(t-2r)I proves injectivity on lower Hamming shells. In odd dimension, eigencharacter complement parity and the adjacency eigen-equation propagate vanishing from central shell to every weight shell. In even dimension, restriction to the first-zero face splits one Laplacian eigenspace into adjacent Walsh degrees, separated by vanishing on complementary middle face layers; odd-case uniqueness kills both and the eigen-equation kills the opposite face. The proposed sets have exactly central-binomial size and attain PBH. An independent exact rational restriction-rank check for d=1,...,6 found all levels full rank; finite checks do not establish the universal claim.
